metadata.title: The Global Escape Velocity Profile and Virial Mass Estimate of The Milky Way Galaxy from Gaia Observations

notes: No eligible star can be listed. The hypervelocity-star data are presented only as aggregate survey samples, such as “HVS P_UB>0.5 (Du 2019)” in I:p4-b0 and “Du 2019 - HVS”/“Li 2022 - HVS” in I:p6-b3, without individual stellar names or catalog identifiers, and the paper gives no star-specific unbound candidacy. The object labeled Leo I is identified as a satellite galaxy, not a star (T:p4-b0; I:p4-b0).
